terms.definition: A public teaching model for maintaining coherent identity, intention, memory, permissions, and policy across changing contexts.
The execution layer that carries out typed work without owning product identity or doctrine.
An explicit grant permitting a bounded action.
A composition of bounded units connected through inputs, outputs, and transformations.
The translation boundary between intention and execution.
Accountable continuity connecting identifiable structure, changing state, and recoverable sequence.
An ordered account of what changed, under which conditions, and through which granted capabilities.
A bounded return to prior state or structure for restoration, revision, and continuation.
The ability to reproduce an execution account when relevant inputs, conditions, and external effects were recorded.
A bounded and amendable promise whose meaning, evidence, tests, version, and challenge path are visible.
A public ethical stance that respects consent, dignity, privacy, proportionality, legibility, and contestability under uncertainty.
The accountable sequence of containment, correction, communication, restoration where possible, retained evidence, and learning against recurrence.
Recorded ancestry and compatibility information used for comparison, rollback, and responsible adaptation without conferring inherited authority.
Visible and inspectable change to methods or expression that does not silently replace identity, purpose, authority, or durable limits.
Optional metaphorical language for meaning and orientation that does not govern runtime behavior.
An optional and revisable way of noticing relationships, uncertainty, transition, memory, or pressure without treating the reading as objective fact.
The ability to inspect, question, transform, recompose, or reject interpretations applied to oneself.
A bounded situation containing entities, relations, pressures, absences, and observer positions.
A metaphor for a bounded traversal with entry, movement, return, closure, and residue.
A metaphor for accumulated salience, dependency, inertia, or unresolved pressure; computational use requires an explicit measurable proxy.
An explicit observable quantity used to operationalize a metaphor while preserving its limits and uncertainty.
